summary: KKR Enhanced US Direct Lending Fund-L Inc., a Delaware closed-end fund (File 814-01724), filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on September 30, 2026 its board declared a dividend of $10.05 per common share, payable on or about October 30, 2026 to holders of record as of the September 30, 2026 close of business. No advisor, premium, stake, or M&A mechanics are referenced; this is an ordinary distribution declaration, not a special situation. Watch only for recurring distribution cadence and any future NAV or tender-related disclosures.
